core.crm.user_inbox_scope.summary: CRM B2/C scope and CX1 projection runtime passed; CX2 Context Bank admission/canary remains explicitly pending.

steps.label: Disk - canonical CRM user-inbox scope owner
steps.detail: CRM owner exposes the versioned envelope and forwards normalized B2/C policy.

steps.label: Runtime - B2/C envelope forwarding
steps.detail: C and B2 envelopes preserve one principal and distinct surface policy keys.

steps.label: Runtime - B2 selected user differs from admin operator
steps.detail: Admin operator resolved a distinct selected principal through the B2 envelope without collapsing to operator user scope.

steps.label: Runtime - one user multi-Page/OA scope union
steps.detail: Multi-Page/OA union is deferred because the current tenant has fewer than two distinct business account fixtures.

steps.label: Runtime - CRM to Context Bank scope handoff
steps.detail: Context Bank scope/access owners and the guarded CX2 CRM scope adapter are loaded; Runtime admission and two-user canary evidence remain pending.

steps.label: Disk - CX2 CRM to Context Bank bridge
steps.detail: The bridge consumes user-inbox-scope and preserves the canonical grant account key.

steps.label: Loader - CX2 CRM scope bridge
steps.detail: The CRM scope bridge is loaded through the Context Bank bootstrap.

steps.label: Runtime - CX1 unified Contacts source memberships
steps.detail: B2/C share the CRM-owned Contacts DTO; source memberships are bounded and provider identifiers are redacted.

steps.label: Runtime - two-user foreign Personal Context Bank canary
steps.detail: Two-user/foreign-Personal canary is deferred because the diagnostics tenant has no current and foreign Personal fixtures.

steps.label: Runtime - CRM scope to archive receipt/pointer admission
steps.detail: No supported CRM customer Inbox fixture is available for a disposable archive receipt.
